item.name: Day
item.cardSummary: The default state of the sky, running seven and a half minutes per cycle. Nothing special happens, which is exactly when you plant and water.

item.name: Sunset
item.cardSummary: A thirty-second yellow-tinted bridge between day and night. Blink and you miss it.

item.name: Night
item.cardSummary: Two minutes of darkness when plants can be stolen from plots, and the moon roll happens: most nights are normal, but Gold, Rainbow, Blood, and Mega moons each have a shot at replacing the plain sky.

item.name: Rain
item.cardSummary: Doubles growth speed for every plant and revives wilted ones. The most common event weather and the one you build harvest timing around.

item.name: Lightning
item.cardSummary: Strikes can hit the map and gift random crops the Electric mutation. Worth keeping valuable crops planted through it.

item.name: Rainbow
item.cardSummary: Boosts the odds of the rainbow mutation and hands you a temporary Rainbow Carpet while the saturated sky lasts.

item.name: Snowfall
item.cardSummary: A short cold snap that can freeze random crops with the Frozen mutation under a white baseplate.

item.name: Starfall
item.cardSummary: Star meteors rain for two minutes with a chance to leave the Starstruck mutation on random crops.

item.name: Aurora
item.cardSummary: Cyan clouds and a soft glow, with a chance to apply the Aurora mutation to random crops.

item.name: Sunburst
item.cardSummary: A giant sun takes over the map and can leave the Ignited mutation on random crops.

item.name: Eclipse
item.cardSummary: The only weather you trigger yourself: harvesting an Eclipse Bloom summons it, and its beams can apply the Eclipsed mutation.

item.name: Blood Moon
item.cardSummary: The rarest natural moon at 2 percent, bathing the map red and applying the Bloodlit mutation.

item.name: Gold Moon
item.cardSummary: Spawns golden seeds around the map, can grant the Midas touch (your first steal turns gold), and can strike plants gold. Seeds need at least two players in the server to spawn.

item.name: Rainbow Moon
item.cardSummary: Drops rainbow seeds, can make your first steal turn rainbow, can strike plants rainbow, and even has a 2 percent chance to spawn a rainbow pet on the map.

item.name: Mega Moon
item.cardSummary: Scatters mega seeds and inflates your avatar while the growing moon shakes the ground.

item.name: Harvest Moon
item.cardSummary: A Fall Harvest world exclusive that speeds up plant and fruit growth under an amber sky.
